title: Where River and Road Remember They Were One

features.name: convergence chip
features.desc-on-touch: Two traces on the board converge here and cease to be separate. The circuit learns that road and river are the same signal traveling different paths.

features.name: flow-trace network
features.desc-on-touch: Golden traces branch like tributaries, like roads branching into towns. Each one remembers it was once water; each one carries the wet-sound of current.

features.name: estuary pool luminescence
features.desc-on-touch: The pool glows with the light of water that has learned to carry current and data. It is both still and flowing.

features.name: data-flow tower
features.desc-on-touch: A tall structure where information rises like water seeking the lowest point. It carries both current and cargo.

features.name: memory-chip archive
features.desc-on-touch: The second chip holds records: what the river was before it became silicon, what the road was before it became signal.

features.name: wireframe confluence
features.desc-on-touch: Where the traces form an open box, an outline of emptiness. The archive maps the place where becoming happens.

inscription: here the circuit board remembers it was water; the water remembers it was always a road back home
